status: Implemented in an isolated test build; not published
baseline: Complete Planner Readable Choices working snapshot, not HEAD alone
request: Check the existing item information broadly, add useful short acquisition sources and use plain language.
changes: Shared item windows now show general worker source types, matched by exact item ID against bundled node outputs.
Trace of Nature: excavation nodes; Egg: chicken farms; powders: relevant mining nodes; other mapped materials use the corresponding source types.
Market, vendor, gathering, garden and processing wording is shorter where it can be safely shortened. Named NPCs, tools, quantities, skills, chance and other restrictions remain.
Existing reviewed farming identities now have a short garden source. Twenty-six crop acquisition summaries and the higher-grade crop description distinguish harvesting produce from breeding seeds.
Cold Draft Beer shows its verified rare cooking source and Skilled 1 requirement.
Exact-ID fallback recovers an existing acquisition record for alternate names such as Griffon Claw. Ambiguous IDs are not combined.
Themes, layout, icons, recipes, quantities, yields, saved notes, profiles, storage, updater and all calculations remain unchanged. No new hover text or runtime network requests.

coverage.qualification: Systematic review of existing reference data and its presentation, not an independent fresh verification of every game fact. The report includes outputs, ingredients, options, substitute ratios, acquisition/vendor entries, exact food/buff/crystal registries and exchange items. Exchange-specific facts and routes are included separately.

uncertainty: Remaining gaps include special cooking outputs whose skill requirements have not been checked, older aliases and bound/reference-only entries. They remain unchanged rather than receiving guessed sources.
Map sources inherit the documented regional and snapshot limits. Node IDs 1826–1829 are excluded. A category does not mean every node in that category produces the item.
Unverified vendor map listings are not promoted into acquisition facts. The existing reviewed farming whitelist is reused, not represented as 46 newly researched item pages.
The existing acquisition and exact-info registries were not all independently re-researched against current official patches. Complex conditions and effects are preserved.
